newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on retail selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks could feel selling pressure on Monday as retail investors are expected to liquidate current positions so they can buy into initial public offerings (IPOs), brokers said. Two issues are now on offer and two more are forthcoming.
"The market sentiment will remain weak. Retailers are selling mostly for cash to buy IPOs whereas institutions are watching," said broker Mohammad Ali.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index droppped 15.46 points or 1.49 percent at 1,032.36 on turnover of 34.1 million.
